thread:
maya: Follow-up from postmortem: recurring OOMs traced to KV cache fragmentation and slow reclamation. We need concrete owners for telemetry, short-term operator fixes, and runtime limits. Keep changes conservative and canary everything.

sam: I will own short-term operator fixes: nightly purge job + an emergency purge endpoint. ETA 2026-04-02. I'll add runbook steps.

jin: I'll own runtime limits/eviction prototype. Plan: per-pool soft cap + async eviction; default soft cap 80% of pool. ETA prototype PR 2026-04-08.

alejandra: I'll add metrics and alerts: kv.cache.frag_ratio (gauge), kv.cache.evictions (counter), alert if frag_ratio>0.8 for 30m. ETA dashboard 2026-03-29.

maya: Good. Add sampled allocation stacks (1/s) with arena tag; retention 14d for now.

ops-bot: Job queued: infra/jenkins#410 -> nightly-jemalloc-purge start 2026-03-26T03:00Z.

sam: Playbook snippet I'll add to infra repo: curl -X POST http://localhost:9001/debug/arena/purge to trigger purge; fallback kill -USR1 <pid>.

jin: Canary plan: 2 hosts, 48h, health gates: RSS<80% host mem, frag_ratio<0.85, p95 latency<1.3x. Rollback if any gate fails.

maya: Owners recap: sam (operator purge + runbook) ETA 2026-04-02; jin (eviction prototype + canary) ETA 2026-04-08; alejandra (telemetry + alerts) ETA 2026-03-29. Post PR links here.

alejandra: Will post dashboard link when ready.

maya: Scheduling check-in Tue 2026-04-05 09:00 PT to review canary. Invite sent.

sam: ack :thumbsup:

jin: pushed local harness to jin/kv-frag-repro (4 writers, 1MB values) - repro in ~40m.

maya: Thanks. Attach flamegraphs to the follow-ups doc. Close thread when canary sign-off done.
